title: Early Neurovascular Adaptations in Aging Women
official: Early Neurovascular Adaptations in Aging Women
summary: Our goal is to enhance our understanding of early vascular adaptations in aging women with an emphasis on the sympathetic nervous system.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Assigned female at birth (AFAB)
* 18-70 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Assigned male at birth (AMAB)
* Pregnancy, breastfeeding
* Body mass index ≥30 kg/m2
* Taking medications known to affect metabolic, autonomic, and/or respiratory function
* Oral hormonal contraception in last 6 month
* History of hormone replacement therapy
* History of hyster- or oophor-ectomy
* Current smoking/Nicotine use
* Increased risk of bleeding, pro-coagulant disorders, clotting disorders, anticoagulation therapy
* Chronic disease
* Blood pressure ≥140/90 mmHg
* Communication barriers
